task_summary: Restart fan diagnosis from the freshly reconnected vehicle, establish live stopped-state evidence and identify the next physical measurement.

acceptance: Obtain fresh telemetry instead of assuming old target or power state.
Independently review the source and capture while retaining one serial owner.
Do not claim software-computed pulse width is a measured electrical signal.
completed: Received 9180 bytes, six consistent zero-target/zero-output/stopped fan replies and 60 status rows.
Recorded mainboard ADC readings and continuing camera sequence with no wheel PWM in this window.
Independent review found no new confirmed software fault and identified passive physical PWM capture as next evidence.
remaining: ESC-terminal supply, signal reception, phase connections and root cause remain unverified.

observations: Fresh connection succeeded where the preceding round received no bytes; this does not isolate why the earlier link failed.
The instrument connection state and physical capture remain an owner-side prerequisite.
A twelve-second stopped capture cannot validate startup behavior or ESC power under load.
Existing historical handoffs were read; no new Opus response was claimed.

recommendations.action: On reconnection capture a bounded stopped baseline and label software-derived values separately from physical measurements before choosing the next test.
recommendations.next_check: Compare the first physical waveform against the current stopped baseline before any new powered fan trial.

evidence: Manufacturer protocol and instrument manual consulted; raw logs and source remain local.
limits: No physical waveform or ESC-terminal voltage acquired.
No fan repair or loaded electrical health established.
No matched workflow baseline; no net speedup claimed.
